Package bakerydms

Class Order

  • java.lang.Object
    • bakerydms.Order
  • public class Order
extends java.lang.Object
    One custom cake order, the object the whole system manages.

    An order has nine attributes: order ID, customer name, phone number, cake type, quantity, unit price, pickup date, picked-up status and special instructions. Each one is a column in the orders database table. This class only holds data and does simple math (calculateSubtotal()). The rules for valid values are in OrderValidator, and OrderManager checks every order before it is stored.

    Example: 

    
 Order order = new Order(1026, "Dana Lee", "407-555-9876", "Red Velvet", 2, 28.00,
         LocalDate.of(2027, 2, 13), false, "Write Happy Birthday, Dana!");
 double subtotal = order.calculateSubtotal(); // 56.00
    Version:
    4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)
    Author:
    Kayla Ewing
